title: Ah scostati… Smanie implacabili
subtitle: Dorabella: recitative and aria from Così fan tutte, Act 1 (No. 11)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 9, No. 11 Recitativo ed Aria
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (finchè; quest' anima and all' Eumenidi as two words).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 73–79, bars 1–126 of No. 11
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (recitative and aria in two page ranges), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by three fresh checkers (two errors found in the recitative, in bars 13 and 24, and corrected; the aria clean). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is a one-quarter upbeat, set as 1/4. Kept as printed: the left hand's A flat in bar 51, where the harmony suggests A natural. Where the print adds a stem for the German words (bars 100 and 108), the Italian rhythm is kept. The cut signs printed above the barlines at bars 104 and 112 are not written in the score. Playback tempo: The recitative at ♩ = 89, then the aria Allegro agitato at a half note = 107 (♩ = 214); about 3 minutes in all, from the median lengths of six recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis, and Gardiner for the recitative); the recitative's Allegro assai and Maestoso keep its pace; Mozart gives the words only.
